label: Q2 2026
method: SEC Form 13F-HR/HR-A information tables, all discretion (SOLE + DFND + SHRD), SH rows only, no put/call; the common-stock CUSIP for each ticker is the candidate reported by the most distinct 13F managers, not the one with the most reported shares — a mislabeled variant can attach a wrong CUSIP with a larger share total, as Rocket Companies' 77311W101 did for Rocket Lab and Hub Group's did for Hubbell. Shared-discretion blocks are de-duplicated by participant set (a DFND/SHRD row's otherManager references are resolved to the other manager's filing via the 13F file number, and each block counts once at the largest amount any participant reported). Even after de-duplication the raw 13F sum can exceed 100% of shares outstanding for heavily shorted/lent stocks (the same shares are reported by both the lender, which still owns them, and the buyer of the shorted shares), so a figure above 100% is the raw filing total, not an aggregation error — independent references show the same for Domino's (109%) and Skyworks (122%) in Q2 2026. Denominator is shares outstanding as of the quarter end (EDGAR cover page). Managers under $100M do not file; small positions and confidential-treatment holdings may be omitted, so the figure can understate true institutional ownership. Insiders % is not in 13F filings.
